written: 2026-09-26, while the cross-validation ran and before any out-of-fold prediction or audit metric was read
status: addendum to the frozen protocol; it adds an engineering check for serving intervals and changes nothing registered there
purpose: decide whether a served rung may label its intervals CALIBRATED (virtual_cell.interface.IntervalKind) and at what level

readouts.transcript_shift_norm: L2 norm of the predicted shift over the modelled genes, log-expression units
readouts.hallmark:<NAME>: mean predicted shift over the Hallmark set's genes present in the modelled universe; only sets with at least 15 such genes

method: cross-conformal by compound fold: for held-out fold k, the absolute residuals of out-of-fold predictions on the other four folds give the finite-sample quantile ceil((n+1)*0.8)/n; Mondrian strata are cell line x dose x structural novelty
novelty: in distribution when the maximum Tanimoto similarity (Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits) to the reference compounds is at least 0.4, the conventional ECFP4 similarity threshold; set here before any result was read

pass.mean_coverage: empirical coverage over all readouts and held-out folds within 0.75 to 0.90
pass.per_readout: at least 90 percent of readouts reach an empirical coverage of 0.70
pass.if_failed: the rung keeps DESCRIPTIVE intervals and the failure is recorded

arm_to_serve: the arm the frozen verdict rules favour; if none passes specific_signal, the simplest arm that does, else none is served
